newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for this week are expected to total $2.2 billion in 110 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 34 sales, with a three-part $400 million Municipal Assistance Corp. for the City of New York deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 76 sales totaling $929 million are on the schedule. A $139 million Cleveland City School District, Ohio, deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $684 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds this week depending on market conditions.
